Adenocarcinoma polmonare (pT1 N0, stadio: Lung adenocarcinoma (pT1 N0, stage IA) of the right upper lobe: part-solid lesion with bubble-like lucencies, grown over one year (NLST 100012)
Donna di 61 anni, fumatrice attiva (crit: 61-year-old woman, current smoker (NLST entry criteria: age 55-74, at least 30 pack-years). Screening program with low-dose CT without contrast. Second annual follow-up (T1). The baseline CT from one year earlier (T0) is available, which had been judged positive for a lesion of the right upper lobe. The exam dates are conventional (the collection shifts the dates: only the interval of about one year matters).
Confronta con la TC basale: descrivi la: Compare with the baseline CT: describe the right upper lobe lesion, its evolution and assign the Lung-RADS category with management.
Nello screening la domanda chiave è semp:
In screening the key question is always the comparison: a growing lesion is suspicious until proven otherwise.

Here the right upper lobe lesion was already present at baseline (T0) as a part-solid lesion with small internal lucencies; at the annual follow-up (T1) the solid component has grown, the margins have become spiculated and the "bubble-like" lucencies (pseudocavitation, bronchi and alveoli spared within the tumor) are more evident. This is the typical picture of lepidic-growth adenocarcinoma with an invasive component.

Lung-RADS v2022: in part-solid nodules the solid component counts. A new or growing solid component of at least 4 mm leads to category 4B; additional suspicious features (spiculation, pseudocavitation, lymph nodes) justify 4X. Management is diagnosis: PET-CT (note that adenocarcinomas with a large lepidic component may have low uptake) and sampling or surgical evaluation.

In reality the patient was diagnosed about 3 months after this follow-up: adenocarcinoma of about 2 cm, pT1 N0 M0, stage IA (AJCC 7th edition).

Pitfalls: mistaking the lucencies for emphysema or bronchiectasis; measuring the total diameter instead of the solid component; not comparing with the prior exam in the same position (use side-by-side viewports and synchronize).
Screening polmonare: confronta sempre co: Lung screening: always compare with the prior; in part-solid nodules the growth of the solid component counts.

In the posterior segment of the right upper lobe, part-solid lesion of about 2 cm, with a solid component of about 1-1.4 cm and small internal lucencies. No other significant nodules. No enlarged lymph nodes, no effusion.

Conclusions: part-solid lesion of the right upper lobe, suspicious: positive screening, diagnostic work-up recommended. (Teaching report written for the case, not the original report.)
